87	### exactOptionalPropertyTypes
88	Supabase Update types use optional properties (`field?: T`). Zod `.optional()` produces `T | undefined`. Under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`, `T | undefined` is NOT assignable to `T?`. Pattern used throughout:

91	const payload: T = {}
92	if (body.data.field !== undefined) payload.field = body.data.field
93	```

457	-- 5b. COMPUTE: fire on bookings UPDATE → status = 'completed'
458	--
459	-- Rule-matching algorithm:
460	--   1. Find all commission_rules where:
461	--      - artist_id matches booking.artist_id
462	--      - service_id matches booking.service_id OR service_id IS NULL
463	--      - effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE
464	--      - effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until >= CURRENT_DATE
465	--   2. Order by: service_id IS NOT NULL DESC (service-specific beats catch-all),
466	--      then priority DESC, then effective_from DESC.
467	--   3. Take the first (best) match.
468	--   4. Compute:
469	--      - If rule has both: commission = round(price * pct/100) + flat_fee
470	--      - If only pct:      commission = round(price * pct/100)
471	--      - If only flat:     commission = flat_fee
472	--      - tip_commission   = round(tip * tip_split_pct / 100)
473	--   5. Fallback to artists.commission_default_pct if no rule found.
474	--   6. INSERT commission_record with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (idempotent).
475	-- -------------------------------------------------------------
476	
477	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_booking_complete_commission()
478	RETURNS TRIGGER
479	LANGUAGE plpgsql
480	SECURITY DEFINER
481	SET search_path = public
482	AS $$
483	DECLARE
484	  v_rule               RECORD;
485	  v_artist             RECORD;
486	  v_commission_cents   INT;
487	  v_tip_commission     INT;
488	  v_snapshot           JSONB;
489	  v_notes              TEXT;
490	  v_price              INT;
491	  v_tip                INT;
492	BEGIN
493	  -- Only fire on the exact transition to 'completed'
494	  IF NEW.status <> 'completed' OR OLD.status = 'completed' THEN
495	    RETURN NEW;
496	  END IF;
497	
498	  v_price := COALESCE(NEW.price_cents, 0);
499	  v_tip   := COALESCE(NEW.tip_cents, 0);
500	
501	  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
502	  -- Step 1: Find best-matching commission rule
503	  -- Priority: service-specific rule > catch-all (service_id IS NULL)
504	  -- Tie-break: higher priority INT, then most recent effective_from
505	  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
506	  SELECT cr.*
507	    INTO v_rule
508	    FROM public.commission_rules cr
509	   WHERE cr.artist_id    = NEW.artist_id
510	     AND (cr.service_id  = NEW.service_id OR cr.service_id IS NULL)
511	     AND cr.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE
512	     AND (cr.effective_until IS NULL OR cr.effective_until >= CURRENT_DATE)
513	   ORDER BY
514	     -- service-specific beats catch-all
515	     (cr.service_id IS NOT NULL) DESC,
516	     -- higher explicit priority wins
517	     cr.priority DESC,
518	     -- most recently effective wins ties
519	     cr.effective_from DESC
520	   LIMIT 1;
521	
522	  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
523	  -- Step 2: Compute commission amounts
524	  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
525	  IF v_rule IS NOT NULL THEN
526	    -- Both percentage and flat_fee: sum both components
527	    IF v_rule.percentage IS NOT NULL AND v_rule.flat_fee_cents IS NOT NULL THEN
528	      v_commission_cents := ROUND(v_price::numeric * v_rule.percentage / 100.0)::int
529	                            + v_rule.flat_fee_cents;
530	      v_notes := NULL;
531	    -- Percentage only
532	    ELSIF v_rule.percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
533	      v_commission_cents := ROUND(v_price::numeric * v_rule.percentage / 100.0)::int;
534	      v_notes := NULL;
535	    -- Flat fee only
536	    ELSE
537	      v_commission_cents := v_rule.flat_fee_cents;
538	      v_notes := NULL;
539	    END IF;
540	
541	    -- Tip split
542	    v_tip_commission := ROUND(v_tip::numeric * v_rule.tip_split_pct / 100.0)::int;
543	
544	    v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
545	      'rule_id',         v_rule.id,
546	      'percentage',      v_rule.percentage,
547	      'flat_fee_cents',  v_rule.flat_fee_cents,
548	      'tip_split_pct',   v_rule.tip_split_pct,
549	      'priority',        v_rule.priority,
550	      'effective_from',  v_rule.effective_from,
551	      'matched_by',      CASE
552	                           WHEN v_rule.service_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'service_specific'
553	                           ELSE 'catch_all'
554	                         END
555	    );
556	  ELSE
557	    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
558	    -- Fallback: use artists.commission_default_pct
559	    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
560	    SELECT commission_default_pct
561	      INTO v_artist
562	      FROM public.artists
563	     WHERE id = NEW.artist_id;
564	
565	    IF v_artist IS NOT NULL AND v_artist.commission_default_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
566	      v_commission_cents := ROUND(v_price::numeric * v_artist.commission_default_pct / 100.0)::int;
567	      -- Default tip split: 100% to artist (same as rule default)
568	      v_tip_commission   := v_tip;
569	      v_notes            := 'no_rule_matched:used_artist_default_pct';
570	      v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
571	        'rule_id',        NULL,
572	        'percentage',     v_artist.commission_default_pct,
573	        'flat_fee_cents', NULL,
574	        'tip_split_pct',  100,
575	        'matched_by',     'artist_default'
576	      );
577	    ELSE
578	      -- No rule and no default — zero commission, flag for manual review
579	      v_commission_cents := 0;
580	      v_tip_commission   := 0;
581	      v_notes            := 'no_rule_matched:no_default:commission_zero';
582	      v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
583	        'rule_id',        NULL,
584	        'percentage',     NULL,
585	        'flat_fee_cents', NULL,
586	        'tip_split_pct',  NULL,
587	        'matched_by',     'none'
588	      );
589	    END IF;
590	  END IF;
591	
592	  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
593	  -- Step 3: Insert commission record (idempotent — ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
594	  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
595	  INSERT INTO public.commission_records (
596	    studio_id,
597	    booking_id,
598	    artist_id,
599	    rule_id,
600	    rule_snapshot,
601	    service_id,
602	    service_price_cents,
603	    tip_cents,
604	    commission_cents,
605	    tip_commission_cents,
606	    calculation_notes,
607	    status
608	  ) VALUES (
609	    NEW.studio_id,
610	    NEW.id,
611	    NEW.artist_id,
612	    CASE WHEN v_rule IS NOT NULL THEN v_rule.id ELSE NULL END,
613	    v_snapshot,
614	    NEW.service_id,
615	    v_price,
616	    v_tip,
617	    v_commission_cents,
618	    v_tip_commission,
619	    v_notes,
620	    'pending'
621	  )
622	  ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING;
623	
624	  RETURN NEW;
625	END;
626	$$;

633	-- 5c. CANCEL: fire on bookings UPDATE → status = 'cancelled' or 'no_show'
634	--
635	-- Behaviour:
636	--   - If existing commission_record is 'pending' → set to 'cancelled'
637	--   - If 'approved' or 'paid' → insert a penalty adjustment
638	--     (negative amount_cents = full commission back to studio)
639	--     so the financial record is preserved. Manual correction required.
640	--   - If already 'cancelled' → no-op
641	-- -------------------------------------------------------------
642	
643	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_booking_cancellation_commission()
644	RETURNS TRIGGER
645	LANGUAGE plpgsql
646	SECURITY DEFINER
647	SET search_path = public
648	AS $$
649	DECLARE
650	  v_record RECORD;
651	BEGIN
652	  -- Only fire on transition to cancelled or no_show
653	  IF NEW.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
654	     OR OLD.status IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') THEN
655	    RETURN NEW;
656	  END IF;
657	
658	  SELECT * INTO v_record
659	    FROM public.commission_records
660	   WHERE booking_id = NEW.id;
661	
662	  -- No commission record — booking was never completed
663	  IF v_record IS NULL THEN
664	    RETURN NEW;
665	  END IF;
666	
667	  IF v_record.status = 'pending' THEN
668	    UPDATE public.commission_records
669	       SET status              = 'cancelled',
670	           cancelled_at        = now(),
671	           cancellation_reason = 'booking_' || NEW.status,
672	           updated_at          = now()
673	     WHERE id = v_record.id;
674	
675	  ELSIF v_record.status IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN
676	    -- Approved/paid commission cannot be silently reversed.
677	    -- Insert a penalty adjustment for manual resolution.
678	    INSERT INTO public.commission_adjustments (
679	      studio_id,
680	      artist_id,
681	      amount_cents,
682	      kind,
683	      reason,
684	      status,
685	      created_by,
686	      metadata
687	    ) VALUES (
688	      NEW.studio_id,
689	      v_record.artist_id,
690	      -(v_record.total_cents),
691	      'penalty',
692	      'Booking cancelled/no_show after commission was ' || v_record.status
693	        || '. Booking ID: ' || NEW.id::text,
694	      'pending',
695	      -- Use service_role identity; no auth.uid() available in trigger context
696	      -- created_by is NOT NULL, so we use a deterministic placeholder:
697	      -- the studio owner resolved at RPC time. Stored as the artist's profile.
698	      -- For trigger context (no session user), we look up a studio admin.
699	      (
700	        SELECT sm.user_id
701	          FROM public.studio_members sm
702	          JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = sm.user_id
703	         WHERE sm.studio_id = NEW.studio_id
704	           AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
705	           AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
706	         ORDER BY sm.created_at
707	         LIMIT 1
708	      ),
709	      jsonb_build_object(
710	        'booking_id',            NEW.id,
711	        'commission_record_id',  v_record.id,
712	        'prior_status',          v_record.status,
713	        'auto_generated',        true
714	      )
715	    );
716	  END IF;
717	  -- status = 'cancelled' or 'disputed': no-op
718	
719	  RETURN NEW;
720	END;
721	$$;

725	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_booking_cancellation_commission();

737	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_commissions(
738	  p_record_ids uuid[]
739	)
740	RETURNS int

742	SECURITY DEFINER
743	VOLATILE
744	SET search_path = public
745	AS $$
746	DECLARE
747	  v_studio_id UUID;
748	  v_count     INT := 0;
749	  v_rec       RECORD;
750	BEGIN
751	  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
752	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
753	  END IF;
754	
755	  -- Iterate and approve each record individually to enforce studio scoping
756	  FOR v_rec IN
757	    SELECT id, studio_id
758	      FROM public.commission_records
759	     WHERE id = ANY(p_record_ids)
760	       AND status = 'pending'
761	  LOOP
762	    -- Verify caller is admin of this record's studio
763	    IF NOT public.user_is_studio_admin(v_rec.studio_id) THEN
764	      CONTINUE; -- skip records from studios the caller doesn't admin
765	    END IF;
766	
767	    UPDATE public.commission_records
768	       SET status      = 'approved',
769	           approved_by = auth.uid(),
770	           approved_at = now(),
771	           updated_at  = now()
772	     WHERE id = v_rec.id;
773	
774	    -- Log to audit trail
775	    INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
776	      actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, studio_id, details
777	    ) VALUES (
778	      auth.uid(),
779	      'commission_approved',
780	      'commission_records',
781	      v_rec.id::text,
782	      v_rec.studio_id,
783	      jsonb_build_object('record_id', v_rec.id)
784	    );

786	    v_count := v_count + 1;
787	  END LOOP;
788	
789	  RETURN v_count;
790	END;

867	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalculate_commission(
868	  p_record_id uuid
869	)
870	RETURNS jsonb
871	LANGUAGE plpgsql
872	SECURITY DEFINER
873	VOLATILE
874	SET search_path = public
875	AS $$
876	DECLARE
877	  v_rec              RECORD;
878	  v_booking          RECORD;
879	  v_rule             RECORD;
880	  v_artist           RECORD;
881	  v_commission_cents INT;
882	  v_tip_commission   INT;
883	  v_snapshot         JSONB;
884	  v_notes            TEXT;
885	  v_price            INT;
886	  v_tip              INT;
887	BEGIN
888	  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
889	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_authenticated');
890	  END IF;
891	
892	  SELECT * INTO v_rec
893	    FROM public.commission_records
894	   WHERE id = p_record_id;
895	
896	  IF v_rec IS NULL THEN
897	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_found');
898	  END IF;
899	
900	  IF NOT public.user_is_studio_admin(v_rec.studio_id) THEN
901	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'forbidden');
902	  END IF;
903	
904	  IF v_rec.status <> 'pending' THEN
905	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_pending', 'current', v_rec.status);
906	  END IF;
907	
908	  -- Re-fetch booking for current price/tip snapshot
909	  SELECT price_cents, tip_cents, service_id, artist_id
910	    INTO v_booking
911	    FROM public.bookings
912	   WHERE id = v_rec.booking_id;
913	
914	  IF v_booking IS NULL THEN
915	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'booking_not_found');
916	  END IF;
917	
918	  v_price := COALESCE(v_booking.price_cents, 0);
919	  v_tip   := COALESCE(v_booking.tip_cents, 0);
920	
921	  -- Re-run rule matching (same algorithm as trigger)
922	  SELECT cr.*
923	    INTO v_rule
924	    FROM public.commission_rules cr
925	   WHERE cr.artist_id    = v_booking.artist_id
926	     AND (cr.service_id  = v_booking.service_id OR cr.service_id IS NULL)
927	     AND cr.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE
928	     AND (cr.effective_until IS NULL OR cr.effective_until >= CURRENT_DATE)
929	   ORDER BY
930	     (cr.service_id IS NOT NULL) DESC,
931	     cr.priority DESC,
932	     cr.effective_from DESC
933	   LIMIT 1;
934	
935	  IF v_rule IS NOT NULL THEN
936	    IF v_rule.percentage IS NOT NULL AND v_rule.flat_fee_cents IS NOT NULL THEN
937	      v_commission_cents := ROUND(v_price::numeric * v_rule.percentage / 100.0)::int
938	                            + v_rule.flat_fee_cents;
939	    ELSIF v_rule.percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
940	      v_commission_cents := ROUND(v_price::numeric * v_rule.percentage / 100.0)::int;
941	    ELSE
942	      v_commission_cents := v_rule.flat_fee_cents;
943	    END IF;
944	    v_tip_commission := ROUND(v_tip::numeric * v_rule.tip_split_pct / 100.0)::int;
945	    v_notes := 'recalculated';
946	    v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
947	      'rule_id',         v_rule.id,
948	      'percentage',      v_rule.percentage,
949	      'flat_fee_cents',  v_rule.flat_fee_cents,
950	      'tip_split_pct',   v_rule.tip_split_pct,
951	      'priority',        v_rule.priority,
952	      'effective_from',  v_rule.effective_from,
953	      'matched_by',      CASE WHEN v_rule.service_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'service_specific' ELSE 'catch_all' END,
954	      'recalculated_at', now()
955	    );
956	  ELSE
957	    SELECT commission_default_pct INTO v_artist
958	      FROM public.artists WHERE id = v_booking.artist_id;
959	
960	    IF v_artist IS NOT NULL AND v_artist.commission_default_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
961	      v_commission_cents := ROUND(v_price::numeric * v_artist.commission_default_pct / 100.0)::int;
962	      v_tip_commission   := v_tip;
963	      v_notes            := 'recalculated:no_rule_matched:used_artist_default_pct';
964	      v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
965	        'rule_id',        NULL,
966	        'percentage',     v_artist.commission_default_pct,
967	        'flat_fee_cents', NULL,
968	        'tip_split_pct',  100,
969	        'matched_by',     'artist_default',
970	        'recalculated_at', now()
971	      );
972	    ELSE
973	      v_commission_cents := 0;
974	      v_tip_commission   := 0;
975	      v_notes            := 'recalculated:no_rule_matched:no_default:commission_zero';
976	      v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
977	        'rule_id',        NULL,
978	        'percentage',     NULL,
979	        'flat_fee_cents', NULL,
980	        'tip_split_pct',  NULL,
981	        'matched_by',     'none',
982	        'recalculated_at', now()
983	      );
984	    END IF;
985	  END IF;
986	
987	  UPDATE public.commission_records
988	     SET rule_id              = CASE WHEN v_rule IS NOT NULL THEN v_rule.id ELSE NULL END,
989	         rule_snapshot        = v_snapshot,
990	         service_price_cents  = v_price,
991	         tip_cents            = v_tip,
992	         commission_cents     = v_commission_cents,
993	         tip_commission_cents = v_tip_commission,
994	         calculation_notes    = v_notes,
995	         updated_at           = now()
996	   WHERE id = p_record_id;
997	
998	  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
999	    actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, studio_id, details

1000	  ) VALUES (
1001	    auth.uid(),
1002	    'commission_recalculated',
1003	    'commission_records',
1004	    p_record_id::text,
1005	    v_rec.studio_id,
1006	    jsonb_build_object(
1007	      'new_commission_cents',     v_commission_cents,
1008	      'new_tip_commission_cents', v_tip_commission
1009	    )
1010	  );
1011	
1012	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
1013	    'ok',                    true,
1014	    'commission_cents',      v_commission_cents,
1015	    'tip_commission_cents',  v_tip_commission,
1016	    'total_cents',           v_commission_cents + v_tip_commission,
1017	    'matched_by',            v_snapshot->>'matched_by'
1018	  );
1019	END;
1020	$$;

1116	RETURNS jsonb

1119	STABLE
1120	SET search_path = public
1121	AS $$
1122	DECLARE
1123	  v_studio_id       UUID;
1124	  v_is_own          BOOLEAN;
1125	  v_is_admin        BOOLEAN;
1126	  v_summary         JSONB;
1127	  v_by_month        JSONB;
1128	  v_adjustments     INT;
1129	BEGIN
1130	  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
1131	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_authenticated');
1132	  END IF;
1133	
1134	  SELECT studio_id INTO v_studio_id
1135	    FROM public.artists
1136	   WHERE id = p_artist_id;
1137	
1138	  IF v_studio_id IS NULL THEN
1139	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'artist_not_found');
1140	  END IF;
1141	
1142	  -- Access check: own artist profile or studio admin
1143	  v_is_own  := EXISTS (
1144	    SELECT 1 FROM public.artists
1145	     WHERE id = p_artist_id AND profile_id = auth.uid()
1146	  );
1147	  v_is_admin := public.user_is_studio_admin(v_studio_id);

1152	
1153	  -- Aggregate commission_records
1154	  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
1155	    'pending_cents',   COALESCE(SUM(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending'), 0),
1156	    'approved_cents',  COALESCE(SUM(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'), 0),

1164	  WHERE artist_id  = p_artist_id
1165	    AND created_at >= p_from::timestamptz
1166	    AND created_at <  (p_to + interval '1 day')::timestamptz;
1167

1170	    INTO v_adjustments
1171	    FROM public.commission_adjustments
1172	   WHERE artist_id  = p_artist_id
1173	     AND status     = 'approved'
1174	     AND applied_at >= p_from::timestamptz
1175	     AND applied_at <  (p_to + interval '1 day')::timestamptz;
1176	
1177	  -- Month-by-month breakdown

1179	    INTO v_by_month
1180	    FROM (
1181	      SELECT
1182	        to_char(date_trunc('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
1183	        COALESCE(SUM(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'), 0) AS approved_cents,
1184	        COALESCE(SUM(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paid'), 0)     AS paid_cents,
1185	        COUNT(*) AS record_count
1186	      FROM public.commission_records
1187	      WHERE artist_id  = p_artist_id
1188	        AND created_at >= p_from::timestamptz
1189	        AND created_at <  (p_to + interval '1 day')::timestamptz
1190	      GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at)
1191	    ) monthly;
1192	
1193	  RETURN v_summary
1194	    || jsonb_build_object(
1195	         'total_adjustments', v_adjustments,
1196	         'net_owed',          COALESCE((v_summary->>'approved_cents')::int, 0) + v_adjustments,
1197	         'by_month',          COALESCE(v_by_month, '[]'::jsonb)
1198	       );
1199	END;
1200	$$;

1369	-- 6h. resolve_dispute(p_dispute_id, p_resolution_notes, p_outcome)
1370	--     RETURNS boolean — owner/admin only.
1371	--     p_outcome: 'upheld' | 'dismissed'
1372	--     If upheld, the commission_record is reset to 'pending'
1373	--     for manual correction (admin may then recalculate or cancel).
1374	-- -------------------------------------------------------------
1375	
1376	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_dispute(
1377	  p_dispute_id       uuid,
1378	  p_resolution_notes text,
1379	  p_outcome          text
1380	)
1381	RETURNS boolean
1382	LANGUAGE plpgsql
1383	SECURITY DEFINER
1384	VOLATILE
1385	SET search_path = public
1386	AS $$
1387	DECLARE
1388	  v_dispute RECORD;
1389	BEGIN
1390	  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
1391	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
1392	  END IF;
1393	
1394	  IF p_outcome NOT IN ('upheld', 'dismissed') THEN
1395	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outcome: must be upheld or dismissed';
1396	  END IF;
1397	
1398	  SELECT * INTO v_dispute
1399	    FROM public.commission_disputes
1400	   WHERE id = p_dispute_id;
1401	
1402	  IF v_dispute IS NULL THEN
1403	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found';
1404	  END IF;
1405	
1406	  IF NOT public.user_is_studio_admin(v_dispute.studio_id) THEN
1407	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
1408	  END IF;
1409	
1410	  IF v_dispute.status <> 'open' THEN
1411	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'dispute_already_resolved: %', v_dispute.status;
1412	  END IF;
1413	
1414	  -- Update the dispute record
1415	  UPDATE public.commission_disputes
1416	     SET status           = CASE p_outcome WHEN 'upheld' THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'dismissed' END,
1417	         resolution_notes = p_resolution_notes,
1418	         resolved_by      = auth.uid(),
1419	         resolved_at      = now(),
1420	         updated_at       = now()
1421	   WHERE id = p_dispute_id;
1422	
1423	  -- If upheld: reset commission_record to 'pending' for correction
1424	  IF p_outcome = 'upheld' THEN
1425	    UPDATE public.commission_records
1426	       SET status         = 'pending',
1427	           dispute_reason  = NULL,
1428	           disputed_by     = NULL,
1429	           updated_at      = now()
1430	     WHERE id = v_dispute.commission_record_id;
1431	  ELSE
1432	    -- Dismissed: restore commission_record to 'approved' (or leave as-was)
1433	    UPDATE public.commission_records
1434	       SET status     = 'approved',
